fix(ci): force JavaScript actions onto Node 24

Summary:
- enable FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24 in trigger and dynamic
  workflows
- keep the updated action replacements intact while forcing remaining
  nested JavaScript actions onto the supported runtime

Rationale:
- remove the Node 20 deprecation warnings still emitted by the dyn-actions
  trigger step and any remaining nested JavaScript actions
- align the psdk workflows with GitHub's recommended migration path
  while validating compatibility on the current branch

Tests:
- git diff --check
- ruby -e 'require "yaml"; %w[.github/workflows/trigger-branch.yml .github/workflows/trigger-tag.yml .github/dyn-workflows/check.yml .github/dyn-workflows/release.yml].each { |f| YAML.load_file(f) }'
